Document.description: A whole deployment: one node or an HA pair.

backup.description: Scheduled backups of the node bundle.

dns.description: Recursive DNS for the served networks.

management.description: Which network is management, and the anti-lockout switch.

networks.description: Layer-2 segments, keyed by network name (also the interface name).

objects.description: Named address and port sets, referenced from rules as `@name`.

ports.description: Per node: port role name to the hardware it is bound to.

provider_options.description:
Per-provider passthrough settings, keyed by provider name. Not
built yet: any entry is rejected.

raw.description: Raw nft statements placed at named hook points.

schema.description:
The oldest schema revision that reads this document: the newest
revision among the fields it uses. Set when the document is
applied; a release refuses one newer than it reads.

zones.description: Named groups of networks. `self` is built in and cannot be defined.

Document.title: Sparewall configuration document

ca.description:
PEM of the CA that signs the directory's TLS certificate, for a
private CA (default: the system trust store).

eab.description: External Account Binding key ID and secret reference.

credentials.description:
Secret reference, `secret:<name>`. For `rfc2136`, the TSIG key as
`algorithm:name:secret`; for lego, the provider's credentials as
`KEY=value` lines.

options.description:
For `rfc2136`, `server` (host[:port]) and `zone`; for lego, the
provider's other environment variables (`GCE_PROJECT`), and lego's
own (`LEGO_DNS_RESOLVERS`).

provider.description:
`rfc2136` (built in), or a lego provider code such as `gcloud`,
`cloudflare` or `route53` (https://go-acme.github.io/lego/dns/).

credentials.description: Secret reference for repository credentials (not the password).

members.description: Member NICs, each a permanent MAC address or udev path.

Document.Cidr.description: IPv4 address with prefix length, e.g. 192.0.2.1/24

conntrack.description: Connection-tracking sizing, identical on both nodes.

hold.description:
Stage beside the gateway this replaces: everything runs, but no
gateway address is claimed (VRRP instances held in FAULT, or not
installed standalone) and DHCP offers nothing. Set false to cut over.

nodes.description:
One node name (standalone) or two (an HA pair). Each is also that
node's hostname: up to 31 lowercase letters, digits and '-',
starting with a letter and not ending with '-'.

sync_keys.description: Each node's sync-tunnel WireGuard public key, from `sparewall status`.

sync_network.description: The network with role `sync` that carries the pair's WireGuard tunnel.

sync_port.description: UDP port of the sync tunnel.

Document.Dhcp.description: DHCPv4: service-wide settings plus one entry per served network.

ha.description: HA mode for a pair. Default `hot-standby`.

ping_check.description:
Ping an address before offering it, and skip it if something
answers: a host still using it without a lease here (after a
restore, or when replacing another DHCP server). Default true; turn
it off on networks that filter ICMP echo.

provider.description: Implementation: `kea` (the default). `networkd` is not built yet.

lease_time.description: Lease time in seconds for this network.

options.description: Options; router, DNS and NTP default to the gateway address.

ping_check.description: Ping before offering on this network (default: `dhcp.ping_check`).

forwarders.description: Forward to these servers instead of recursing.

networks.description: Networks to serve; default every network with DHCP.

records.description: Extra local A records, name to address.

network.description: The network whose addresses fill the set.

source.description: `address` for the node's own address, `prefix` for the subnet.

dst.description: Original destination; default any address of the arriving zone.

from.description: Zone the connections arrive from. Default `wan`.

hairpin.description:
Inside zones whose clients may also use the forward by its outside
address (NAT reflection), e.g. `[users]`. Needs `dst`. Clients on
the server's own network are also source-NATed to the firewall's
address there, so that replies come back through it.

connections.description: Record connection start/end with NAT mappings.

group.description: nflog group used for rule logging. Default 0.

anti_lockout.description:
Always accept SSH and HTTPS from the management network to `self`.
Only an `admin` may turn this off.

web.description:
Serve the web UI and the HTTP API (`sparewall-httpd`) on the HTTPS
port, next to the health endpoints. Off by default; reached only
where HTTPS is, the management network.

password.description:
Also accept the `admin` password (`sparewall passwd`) over SSH, not
only keys. Off by default: the password is the console's
break-glass path.

Document.Match.description: A match value: a scalar, a list, or an `@object` reference.

mode.description:
`external`: `/metrics` answers the management network without a
token, for an external Prometheus. `off`: not served. (Without a
`metrics` section it needs a token.) `local` (a local Prometheus)
is not built yet and is rejected.

retention.description:
Local Prometheus retention, e.g. `15d`. Not built yet, with the
local mode: rejected.

addresses.description: Each node's own address on this network, in CIDR form.

cake.description: WAN shaping with CAKE, e.g. `{ egress: 900mbit }`.

dhcp_client.description: Obtain this node's address by DHCP (WAN or management only).

dns.description: Upstream DNS servers learned statically on this network.

extra_vips.description:
More addresses that move with the gateway address (in its VRRP
instance in a pair; static standalone), for forwards and SNAT, e.g.
a mail server's public address. In the gateway address's subnet.

gateway.description:
Upstream gateway (default route) for a static WAN or a management
network with its own upstream.

lldp.description: Emit and receive LLDP on this network. Default true on untagged ports.

port.description: The port role this network rides on.

role.description: What the network is for. Default `service`.

vip.description:
The gateway address clients use. Moved by VRRP in a pair, a plain
static address on a standalone node.

vlan.description: 802.1Q VLAN ID; omit for the untagged network of a port.

vmac.description:
On a pair's WAN with private node addresses and a static block:
carry the gateway addresses and the public route behind the VRRP
virtual MAC (`00:00:5e:00:01:<vrid>`), so a handover changes no MAC
the upstream sees (the default). `false` puts them on the nodes'
own MACs, for an upstream that limits the MACs it learns on a port.
Not `cluster.vrrp.use_vmac`, keepalived's own virtual MAC for the
other networks' instances.

vrid.description: VRRP virtual router ID (1-255), unique across the deployment.

Document.Object.description: A named set: static elements, or a dynamic set filled by networkd.

dynamic.description: Fill from a network's addresses instead (`ipv4` only).

elements.description:
Static elements: addresses or prefixes for `ipv4`, ports or ranges for
`port`.

Document.Policy.description: Policy for traffic from one zone to another.

action.description: What happens to traffic no rule matched.

log.description: Log traffic that reaches the default action.

nat.description: Source NAT applied to this zone pair.

Document.Port.description: What a port role is bound to on one node.

mtu.description: MTU of the port (VLAN networks may set their own, no larger).

nic.description:
One NIC, matched by permanent MAC address (`52:54:00:aa:00:01`) or by
udev path (`pci-0000:01:00.0`).

offload.description: NIC offload overrides for misbehaving drivers.

Document.RawEntry.description: A raw nft statement placed at a hook point.

nft.description: The nft statement, without a trailing comment.

order.description: Position among raw entries at the same point.

oneOf.description: Prerouting at raw priority (`notrack`, early drops).
Forward, before zone dispatch (global blocks, MSS clamping).
Postrouting at source-NAT priority (custom SNAT, marks).

hostname.description: Hostname to hand out (and publish in local DNS).

action.description: What to do with matching packets.

dport.description: Destination port(s): a number, `low-high`, a list, or `@object`.

dst.description: Destination: an address, a prefix, a list of them, or `@object`.

order.description: Position within the zone pair; leave gaps (100, 200, ...).

proto.description: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` or another protocol name nft knows.

sport.description: Source port(s): a number, `low-high`, a list, or `@object`.

src.description: Source: an address, a prefix, a list of them, or `@object`.

check.description:
Check the channel for a newer image every few hours, and log when
one appears (on by default). `false` keeps the node from contacting
the registry on its own, for an air-gapped site; `sparewall upgrade
--check` still asks when run.

mode.description:
`manual` (the default): upgrades run when asked for, with
`sparewall upgrade`. `windowed` (automatic upgrades in `window`) is
not built yet and is rejected.

window.description:
Maintenance window as a systemd calendar expression. Not built yet,
with the windowed mode: rejected.

client_allowed_ips.description: Networks routed through the tunnel in client configs; default all.

dns.description: DNS servers pushed in client configs.

endpoint.description: Public name or address clients connect to.

extra_ports.description:
More UDP ports clients may use from networks that block the listen
port, e.g. `[53, 443]`: redirected to it on the WAN gateway address.

zone.description: The zone the tunnel interface belongs to.

preshared_key.description:
WireGuard preshared key, a cluster secret: `secret:<name>`. The
client must be configured with the same key (`wg genpsk`).

advert_interval_cs.description: Advertisement interval in centiseconds (VRRPv3). Default 100 (1 s).

preempt_delay_s.description:
Fail back by itself: the node with the higher priority takes the
gateway addresses back once it has been up and eligible for this
many seconds (1-1000). Unset (the default), the pair never
preempts, so it cannot bounce while that node flaps; move the
addresses with `sparewall failover` instead. The delay is then the
only protection against flapping.

priority.description: VRRP priority per node; give the larger node the higher value.

unicast.description: Send adverts unicast to the peer instead of multicast.

Error.description: A Varlink error: its name and parameters, and a message in words. The HTTP status follows the error (422 ValidationFailed, 409 Conflict, NotPending and ConfirmTimeout, 401 PermissionDenied without credentials and 403 with them, 404 NotFound, MethodNotFound and InterfaceNotFound, 503 PeerUnreachable, 400 NotSupported, InvalidParameter and malformed calls, 500 the rest; the gateway's own: 502 Unavailable, 404 NotFound, 405 MethodNotAllowed, 413 TooLarge).

parameters.description: `role` is `none` on a connection not bound to a token.
Calls are POST; files are GET.
No call or file has this path.
The request body is over the gateway's limit.
The coordinator did not answer the gateway.
Method is expected to be called with 'more' set to true, but wasn't.
The requested interface was not found.

interface.description: The interface that was not found.

parameters.description: One of the passed parameters is invalid.
The requested method was not found.

method.description: The method that was not found.

parameters.description: The interface defines the requested method, but the service does not implement it.

method.description: The method that is not implemented.

expires.description: Unix time it expires, if ever.

locked.description: No password: the user cannot log in.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document (empty for bootstrap).

session.description: A browser session from org.sparewall.Auth.Login. Requests with it must also carry the X-Sparewall-Request header.
session.name: sparewall_session

info.description: The Sparewall coordinator's Varlink interfaces over HTTPS, as sparewall-httpd serves them. Each call is checked against the role of the caller's API token or session (x-sparewall-role).
